top_signals.title: Treasuries Hold Gains After Fed Boosts Rates, Forecasts More
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries mostly held their gains after the Federal Reserve lifted interest rates for the first time since 2023 and forecast further action to rein in inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Fed Has Started a Rate-Hiking Cycle, Swonk Says
top_signals.summary: KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk says the Federal Reserve is at the the beginning of a rate-hiking cycle and if inflation is still sticky in 2027, more cuts will be needed. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: House passes bill to equip local law enforcement with scam-fighting tools
top_signals.summary: The Guarding Unprotected Aging Retirees from Deception Act (GUARD) attempts to address a common complaint from the victims of online scams like pig butchering — that such cases typically do not rise to the level of a federal investigation but local law enforcement is unequipped to properly investigate them.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Continental Strikes Venezuela Oil Deal with PDVSA
top_signals.summary: Continental Resources signed a memorandum of understanding with Venezuela's state oil company PDVSA on Wednesday to operate and develop the Ayacucho 2 Block in the Orinoco Belt, the company announced, with an estimated 30 billion barrels of resource in place across roughly 126,000 acres in Anzoátegui state.  The two sides intend to advance a long-term Contrato de Participación Productiva agreement in the coming weeks; once it's signed, Continental will operate the block with a 100% working interest. The deal is one in a flurry…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
